articles.title: Trump Media pulls back from crypto, scraps Crypto.com's CRO token treasury deal
articles.snippet: The Truth Social parent company is refocusing on media and its pending merger with a fusion energy firm, as the digital asset treasury boom has lost its steam.

articles.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin director Justin Mateen buys nearly $2 million of ABTC stock
articles.snippet: Mateen purchased more than 306,000 shares across two days following the company's quarterly earnings, lifting his stake to more than 492,000 shares.

articles.title: Donald Trump’s media company to terminate Crypto.com deal
articles.snippet: The president’s company will unwind an agreement with Crypto.com to create a multibillion-dollar CRO treasury and reportedly not integrate prediction markets onto Truth Social.

articles.title: Trump Media Abandons Crypto Treasury, Prediction Market Ventures
articles.snippet: Truth Social's parent company is unwinding two major Crypto.com deals as new leadership shifts its focus to media, data licensing, and a planned merger with fusion energy company TAE.

articles.title: Bitcoin Payment Service BTCPay Warns Critical Flaw Is Under Active Attack
articles.snippet: Bitcoin company BTCPay Server told users to install the latest version of the server and replace credentials that may have been exposed.
